description.en: The description. The description can be up to 200 characters in length.

description.zh: IP访问控制的ID，代表了唯一的IP控制策略
description.en: The ID of the ACL. The ID is unique.

description.zh: IP访问控制名称。支持大小写英文字母、中文、数字、下划线（_）、长度为[4,50]个字符, 且不能以下划线开头。
description.en: The name of the ACL. The name must be 4 to 50 characters in length, and can contain letters, digits, and underscores (\_). The name cannot start with an underscore (\_).

descriptions.zh:
- 此功能面向API提供者
- 该接口只能修改访问控制的名称和描述，访问控制类型不支持修改。
descriptions.en:
- This operation is intended for API providers.

- This operation allows you to modify only the name and description of an ACL. You cannot modify the type of the ACL.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cloudapi modify-ip-control --ip-control-id 7ea91319a34d48a09b5c9c871d9768b1 --ip-control-name testControl11 --description description --api-version 2016-07-14 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun cloudapi ModifyIpControl --region cn-hangzhou --Description description --IpControlName testControl11 --IpControlId 7ea91319a34d48a09b5c9c871d9768b1
